summary.text: Clint Okerlund is a Republican member of the Utah House of Representatives for District 42, in office since 2025, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026, general election.
A chief financial officer by profession, he has a business degree from Brigham Young University and a graduate degree from the University of Notre Dame.

paragraphs.text: Okerlund was born in Utah and earned a bachelor's degree from Brigham Young University in 2001 and a graduate degree from the University of Notre Dame in 2004.

In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, he said he grew up in Richfield, Utah, worked at Zions Bank and for 14 years at Bank of America, and then became chief financial officer of a start-up biotech laboratory in Sandy.
Okerlund took office in 2025, succeeding Robert Spendlove.

In the same survey he described himself as a "Reagan Republican" favoring practical policies over partisan politics, and he listed education funding, air quality, housing affordability, transportation infrastructure, homelessness, abortion policy and restoring the Great Salt Lake among the challenges Utah faces.
